topic: Stain Removal Golden Rule: Promptness and Cold Water
questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Stains should be treated as immediately as possible while still fresh, because aging, oxidation, and heat set stains into fibers permanently.
Statement II: Unknown or protein-based stains (blood, egg, milk) must NEVER be treated with hot water initially, as heat coagulates proteins, permanently bonding them to fibers.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

Hence, option (C) is correct.

topic: Color Harmonies / Color Schemes and Examples
questionText:
Match the color harmony in List I with its color combination in List II (based on the 12-color Prang Color Wheel):

List I:
(A) Monochromatic Harmony
(B) Analogous Harmony
(C) Complementary Harmony
(D) Triadic Harmony

List II:
(I) Tints, tones, and shades of a single hue (e.g., light sky blue, royal blue, and navy blue)
(II) Two to three hues situated directly adjacent to each other on the color wheel (e.g., yellow, yellow-green, and green)
(III) Two hues situated directly opposite each other on the color wheel (e.g., red and green, or blue and orange)
(IV) Three hues positioned equidistant from each other, forming an equilateral triangle (e.g., red, yellow, and blue)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II

Monochromatic uses one hue variations; Analogous uses adjacent hues; Complementary uses opposite hues; Triadic uses equidistant hues.

topic: Commercial Hospital Laundry Operational Workflow Sequence
questionText:
Arrange the sequential operational workflow stages through which soiled hospital linen passes in a commercial laundry:
(A) Collection of soiled/infected linen from hospital wards in designated color-coded bags
(B) Sorting, weighing, and classifying linen into soiled, infected, and specialty categories
(C) Washing, thermal/chemical disinfection, bleaching, souring, and high-speed hydro-extraction
(D) Drying, flatwork ironing/calendering, quality inspection, folding, and packaging for redistribution

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Hospital laundry workflow follows: collection & bagging (A) -> sorting & classification (B) -> washing & disinfection (C) -> ironing, inspection & dispatch (D).
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
